scripts.text:
[Starfish]
You alone is powerless, hehe!
Better get someone to help you out.
Make a party, and come back later.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
一個人可沒什麼勝算，嘿嘿！
找些幫手，組好隊伍再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
Where is your leader, hehe.
I don't talk to some random people.
Bring your boss to me.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
隊長呢，嘿嘿？
我可不是什麼人都搭理的，把你們頭兒叫來。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
I am guarding here, hehe!
It is just roughly blocked for now.
But someday this cave must be sealed forever, hehe!
scripts.translation:
[海星]
我在這裡守著呢，嘿嘿！
眼下只是勉強堵上，總有一天得把這洞穴徹底封死，嘿嘿！

scripts.text: Ask what's going on.
scripts.translation: 詢問發生了什麼事

scripts.text: Ask to open the gate.
scripts.translation: 請求開啟大門

scripts.text: Go to other location.
scripts.translation: 前往其他地點

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
Lately, our Starfish lady is
suffering with some issues, ooh ooh.
Something bad happen in this
peaceful place, hehe!
scripts.translation:
[海星]
最近海星女士遇上了麻煩，嗚嗚。
這麼太平的地方，竟然出了這種事，嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
Weird looking limbs came out
from the hole there,
tried to kidnap our lady Starfish.
Ooh Ooh.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
那洞裡伸出些怪模怪樣的觸手，想把海星女士擄走。
嗚嗚。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
It seems those limbs belong to
that ugly octopus.
That monster should be taken care of,
but it's hard for ourselves only to make it happen, hehe.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
那些觸手好像是那隻醜章魚的。
得收拾那隻魔物才行，但光靠我們自己很難辦到，嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
I want to find someone special,
and ask to punish this ugly octopus.
I hope this octopus won't ever
harass our lady, hehe.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
想找個厲害的人，替我們教訓那隻醜章魚，讓它再也不敢騷擾海星女士，嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
Go catch that octopus and stick it to this pick.
If you bring back the pick, I will
open this gate for a while.
You should challenge if you are interested, hehe.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
去抓住那隻章魚，把它串在這根捕章魚棍上。
如果你把捕章魚棍帶回來，我就暫時開啟這扇門。
有興趣的話就去挑戰吧，嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
Octopus is not around now, hehe.
Please come back later.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
章魚現在不在附近，嘿嘿。
請稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
Party name is... {0}.
Party leader is... {1}.
^0000ffOctopus Cave^000000, I cannot open now, hehe.
Now is not the time, please wait.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
隊伍名稱...{0}。
隊長...{1}。
^0000ff章魚密穴^000000現在還不能開啟，嘿嘿。
現在還不是時候，請稍等。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
I will open the gate for a while to ^0000ffOctopus Cave^000000.
Please catch that pervert octopus,
and come back with it sticked to the pick, hehe.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
我會暫時開啟通往^0000ff章魚密穴^000000的大門。
抓住那隻變態章魚，把它串在捕章魚棍上再回來，嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
Prepare a pick first,
so you can thread that octopus
with that pick.
Then, I will let you in for a while, hehe.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
先準備一根捕章魚棍，這樣才能把那隻章魚串起來。
然後，我就讓你暫時進去，嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
This is not a good location, check someplace else.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
這裡不是個好地方，去別處看看吧。

scripts.text:
There is a strange entrance
blocked roughly with some boards.
scripts.translation: 有一個奇怪的入口，被幾塊木板草草堵住了。

scripts.text: Go in.
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
Ah, now is not the time...
Would you come back later? Hehe.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
啊，現在不是時候...
你能稍後再來嗎？嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
There is a secret with that entrance.
So, please be careful with it, will ya? Hehe.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
那個入口有個秘密。
所以，請小心一點，好嗎？嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
Shhh... Weird aura is
coming from that entrance.
Big trouble is waiting, if you go in now.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
噓...那個入口傳來古怪的氣息，現在進去可會有大麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
You should definitely prepare
hunting stick if you want to
punish the Octopus.
Or I will not let you in! Hehe.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
想懲罰章魚的話，一定要先準備好捕章魚棍。
不然我可不會放你進去！嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Starfish]
Yes Yes, you better quit.
scripts.translation:
[海星]
對對，還是別去了。

scripts.text: Do you want to go out from the octopus dungeon?
scripts.translation: 要離開章魚副本嗎？

scripts.text: No!
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 是
